title: Nuevo Laredo Breaks Ground on Margarita Maza High School as Three Governments Invest in Education
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo laid the first stone of the Bachillerato Nacional Margarita Maza and unveiled more than 4.2 million pesos in upgrades at COBAT 23, part of a joint federal, state and municipal push to expand high school access.
content:
Nuevo Laredo has broken ground on a new high school, the Bachillerato Nacional Margarita Maza, in the Valles del Paraíso neighborhood in the south of the city, as municipal and state officials carried out a day of education works and deliveries on Nov. 13, according to CML Noticias.

The school is part of the federal Plan Integral del Sistema Nacional de Bachillerato de la Nueva Escuela Mexicana, aimed at increasing high-school coverage and bringing campuses closer to residential areas. The city donated the land for the project, in a sector that has seen significant population growth.

During the same workday, officials inaugurated improvements and delivered equipment at the Colegio de Bachilleres de Tamaulipas, Plantel 23 “El Bayito,” where more than 4.24 million pesos were invested through municipal, federal and school-system contributions.

The city invested 2,845,538 pesos in a wall, roofing, a classroom, restrooms and lighting; the federal La Escuela es Nuestra program applied 899,817 pesos to a gate, a court and flooring; and COBAT contributed 495,000 pesos for air conditioning, furniture and computer equipment, according to the report.

Officials also inaugurated a new Centro de Estudios de Bachillerato, created by converting the Escuela Secundaria México 2000 facilities to offer high school classes in the evening shift. The city contributed a perimeter fence and replacement window glass to improve safety and function.

The day also included delivery of the state’s Becas Transformación “Avanza” scholarships for the 2026-2027 school year, with more than 1,000 scholarships delivered during the visit, according to the state Education Department.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal led the activities with Tamaulipas Education Secretary Miguel Ángel Valdez García. “Estas acciones reflejan los grandes resultados que obtenemos cuando los tres niveles de gobierno unimos voluntades y corazones por un mismo fin: el bienestar de nuestra niñez y juventud,” Canturosas Villarreal said.

Sources: CML Noticias, “Impulsan nuevas preparatorias y obras educativas en Nuevo Laredo con inversión de los tres niveles de gobierno,” Nov. 13, 2026. cmlnoticias.com ; Revista Debate, “Tamaulipas destina más de mil millones de pesos a infraestructura educativa en Nuevo Laredo durante cuatro años de gestión,” Nov. 13, 2026. revistadebate.click
